<!-- pr-reviewer: 554803d1fb3356faaa15b4a96211ec11c0405d39 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks @austin62jake - a tidy, well-pinned fix.

**What looks good**
- Exit move: when the bar's far end (`s_top`) runs past the ride's end, the radial exit is a feed at the plunge feed, never a rapid through stock (`crates/motion/src/turning/prof.rs` `Exit::Feed`, `stock.rs` `runs_past`). A non-finite `s_top` or no stock keeps the old path, so nothing new rapids through stock.
- No unwrap/expect/panic or unchecked indexing added; the new `cl[...]` access is the existing one. Contour kinds keep `Rapid` and are documented as unchanged.
- Provenance lines updated; files stay under 400 lines (`prof.rs` 321, `stock.rs` 68).
- Decision record in `docs/decisions/229-rough-bar-end.md` (not RECOMMENDED.md), with alternatives considered. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #229`; it states what was and was not run. No CHANGELOG.md edits, no deps/build.rs/workflow/script changes.

**Local results (trial-merged with current origin/main, no conflicts, Windows)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| motion `turning_stock` / `turning_prof` / `turning_contour` / `turning_blade` | 5 / 8 / 13 / 11 pass |
| motion lib | 149 pass |
| app `turning_axial_rapids` / `turning_stock_approach` / `lathe_post` / `turning` | 3 / 3 / 7 / 5 pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The contour kinds (multi-pass, chamfer, taper) still read no stock, so a multi-pass in a longer bar would still rapid out through it; the meridian law would flag it. Worth a follow-up issue.
- The feed-out is radial at the plunge feed all the way to the clear radius, including the air portion above the bar's OD; the decision record accepts that cost.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
